title: The first exploration of coordination chemistry using a methyl substituted o-vanillin based ligand: an example starting with Dy4/Zn2Dy2 systems displaying slow relaxation of magnetization

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (110 mg, 0.25 mmol) was reacted with H2L (128 mg, 0.5 mmol) in the presence of Et3N (1.0 mmol, 100 mg) in 30 mL of methanol under reflux for about 1 h. After cooling, the mixture was filtered and the clear dark yellow filtrate was kept at ambient temperature for slow evaporation. Block-shaped orange crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed within a week, were filtered off, washed with methanol/ether and air dried. Yield: 0.437 g, 64%.
synthesis.time: about 1 h (reflux); crystals within a week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in methanol under aerobic conditions, then slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after cooling; filtrate evaporated at ambient temperature; crystals washed with methanol/ether and air dried

properties.summary: Butterfly Dy4 cluster showing slow magnetic relaxation at zero dc field (SMM-like) with no χ″ maxima down to 2 K up to 1400 Hz; χT decreases then rises slightly below 6 K, consistent with weak ferromagnetic Dy···Dy interaction; no hysteresis at 2 K. Approximate Ueff ≈ 3.5 K and τ0 ≈ 1×10−5 s from a Kramers–Kronig Arrhenius fit.

measurements.conditions: zero dc field; same Arrhenius estimate as Ueff

synthesis.procedure: A methanolic solution of triethylamine (100 mg, 1.00 mmol) was added to H2L (129 mg, 0.50 mmol) dissolved in 20 mL of methanol under continuous stirring. Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (110 mg, 0.25 mmol) and Zn(CH3COO)2·2H2O (55 mg, 0.25 mmol) were added with stirring, and the dark yellow solution was heated to reflux for ca. 1 h. After cooling, the mixture was filtered and the filtrate left undisturbed for crystallization. After several days, block-shaped yellow crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained, filtered, washed with methanol and air dried. Yield not reported.
synthesis.time: ca. 1 h (reflux); crystals after several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring then reflux in methanol under aerobic conditions, then undisturbed crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after cooling; filtrate left undisturbed; crystals washed with methanol and air dried

properties.summary: Butterfly Zn2Dy2 cluster with field-supported slow magnetic relaxation; zero-field χ″ is very weak, while in-phase and out-of-phase ac signals improve under 1000 Oe. χT is nearly constant to 150 K then falls to 18 emu K mol−1; no hysteresis at 2 K. Approximate Ueff ≈ 3.1 K and τ0 ≈ 9×10−6 s from a Kramers–Kronig Arrhenius fit (1000 Oe).
